definitions.gloss: menopause; climacteric period; change of life
definitions.explanation: the period of life (typically mid-40s to mid-50s) when menstruation ceases and hormone levels change, often accompanied by various physical and emotional symptoms

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{更年期|こうねんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: My mother is troubled by menopausal symptoms.

examples.japanese: {更年期|こうねんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体調管理|たいちょうかんり}→体調管理：15302_taichoukanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Managing your health is important during menopause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{更年期|こうねんき}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{更年|こうねん} (turning point of age) + {期|き} (period)

COMMON SYMPTOMS ({更年期|こうねんき}{症状|しょうじょう}):
- ⟦ホット→ホット：10172_hotto⟧⟦フラッシュ→フラッシュ：08811_furasshu⟧ - hot flashes
- ⟦{発汗|はっかん}→発汗：13705_hakkan⟧ - sweating
- ⟦{不眠|ふみん}→不眠：11078_fumin⟧ - insomnia
- ⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧ - mood swings
- {疲労感|ひろうかん} - fatigue

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {更年期|こうねんき}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧ - menopausal disorder
- {更年期|こうねんき}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧ - menopausal symptoms
- ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧{更年期|こうねんき} - male menopause (andropause)

USAGE:
While traditionally associated with women, ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧{更年期|こうねんき} (male menopause/andropause) has become a recognized condition in Japan.
